item.title: OpenGL Game Engine
item.description: Is primarily an early-stage game engine for Windows written in C++

item.title: At Deaths Door
item.description: A prototype to show all the features of my action-adventure framework developed in C++

item.title: Operation Crimson Day

item.title: NDS Game
item.description: An short puzzle videogame for NDS where the player must go throught a dungeon in a limited number of movements.
